from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u080/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    color = grid[points[0][0]][points[0][1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if row_lines:
        line = row_lines[0]
        rs = [r for r, c in points]
        if min(rs) > line:
            dr = line + 1 - min(rs)
            stripe = max(rs) + dr + 1
        else:
            dr = line - 1 - max(rs)
            stripe = min(rs) + dr - 1
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in points:
            out[r + dr][c] = color
        if 0 <= stripe < h:
            out[stripe] = [8] * w
    else:
        line = col_lines[0]
        cs = [c for r, c in points]
        if min(cs) > line:
            dc = line + 1 - min(cs)
            stripe = max(cs) + dc + 1
        else:
            dc = line - 1 - max(cs)
            stripe = min(cs) + dc - 1
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c + dc] = color
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
'''
